# rulecheck nounlines baseline: noun, count (the Go lines that name it), reason (tab separated).
# Rule: a function or method counts whole (its declaration, doc comment excluded) for a noun when it names the noun: a string literal NOUN or NOUN followed by . : / (a verb key, a row id, a key table), a package-level constant holding one, or an identifier NOUN[s] alone or followed by [A-Z0-9_] (case of the first letter free: pane, paneRow, PaneCopy, panes; panesd does not); a function naming several nouns counts for each; non-test, non-generated .go files of the scanned directories.

# into a hooks file must not count as removing it). Every count may only fall: RULECHECK_UPDATE=1 lowers it, never raises it;
# a step that adds a noun's lines raises its row as a reviewed edit with a reason. Seeded 2026-11-17 by run plan 5.4a; every
# step that removes a store or page file reports these numbers before and after.
